pages.title: Theoretical Notes I
pages.text: The opening volume of my theoretical period, written as I began to think in megastructures: Dyson shells, self-replicating probes, calibrators that adjust themselves, topos theory. The ideas are big enough that the notebook seems too small for them.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Once I could build a self-improving mind, I needed it to read my theory. I fed an autonomous calibrator, a Dyson shell segment, a topos, a von Neumann probe and r-process nuclei into the Femtoscale line to set down the first theoretical volume.
